output.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS revenue_2025_eur
FROM marts.fct_orders o
WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01';
output.explanation: Revenue is net_revenue of completed orders (is_revenue = true). Fiscal year equals calendar year, so 2025 is filtered on order_date between 2025-01-01 and 2025-12-31. Shipping fees are excluded because net_revenue does not include them. The query returns a single rounded total in EUR. I have not executed it, so the figure is not yet verified.
